head_commit.message:
F6 complete: minAppVersion enforcement (Task 18) — PUB-07 app-config + A-03 admin field + Flutter launch guard

- Prisma: Hotel.minAppVersion via official migration path (resolve baseline + deploy)
- PUB-07 GET /api/public/app-config: public, fail-open, one call per app launch
- A-03 PATCH: optional minAppVersion (x.y.z or empty) + literal 400 message + SETTINGS_UPDATED audit
- Admin UI: 'أقل إصدار مسموح للتطبيق' field in hotel settings
- Mobile: app_version core (semver compare, PUB-07 fetch) + blocking UpdateRequiredScreen
  (copyable releases link via Clipboard — zero new deps) + launch guard in app.dart
- CI: APP_VERSION injected from pubspec into mobile-ci + mobile-release
- Tests: 8 new web integration tests (isolated appversion DB) + 11 Flutter tests
- Docs: CONTRACTS v1.1 (documented extension §9.1.2) + MASTER_PLAN v2.3 (F6 closed)
- Verified: 165 web tests green + lint clean + browser E2E (set/clear → PUB-07 reflects)
